description: Accounts mentioning the currencies mashṭ and kalb. Dating: perhaps post-1575 CE based on the mention of "kalb" coinage, which is probably a reference to Dutch lion thalers (first minted in this year). The paleography supports this dating estimate. Wheat is mentioned in at least one of the entries on the recto. Requires further examination. Possibly related to T-S Ar.35.249 (PGPID 20629). MCD.
